why: A (universe 0) is theorem_16_3_17_two with three side conjuncts: theorem_16_3_17_two_hyp (reflexive local step hloc assumed instead of tameness), its satisfiability witness, and the ep-level local step EpStrongBundle.hasReflexiveLocalExtensions_of_isTame. The main conjunct assumes c tame, IsAuxNormBoundary n and one structure S ∈ c̄ that has reflexive 1-fibres and in which normOf n is a reflexive auxiliary norm over ∂X. B assumes c.polyfold.IsTame (= c.IsTame by definition), c.HasReflexiveFibers (in some structure) and IsAuxNormBoundary n with some S ∈ c̄ in which normOf n is reflexive over ∂X. The two hypotheses differ only in whether the reflexive fibres sit in the same structure as the reflexive norm, and HasReflexiveFibers.of_mem (every structure then has them) closes that gap; the conclusions coincide. The side conjuncts do not follow from B (the _hyp form has no tameness); they are re-proved outright from non-item lemmas (theorem_12_2_13_hyp, exists_reflexiveLocalExtension_of_isTame, theorem_12_2_11_exists, the descend lemmas).
